name: getgroups
description: getgroups() returns the supplementary group IDs of the calling process and stores them in the provided list array. The size parameter specifies the maximum number of items that can be stored; if size is zero, it returns the total number without modifying the list.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The maximum number of supplementary group IDs to store in the list, or zero to retrieve the total count.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Array to store the supplementary group IDs.

return_value.success: Returns the number of supplementary group IDs.
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno to indicate the error.

errors.description: size is less than the number of supplementary group IDs but not zero.
